'''Zemex''' was a [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve agent]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. An [[Interrogation droid/Legends|Interrogation droid]] known only as [[It (IT-3 Interrogator)|IT]] planned to use it to assassinate [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|leaders]]. The plot was foiled by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], and their son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]].
